description.value:
Cost 1 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

They go flat and lidless, and they do not blink for the whole minute. People notice.

You gain darkvision, and imprecise scent to 30 feet. For the duration you take a −2 circumstance penalty to Deception checks and to any check that depends on someone reading your face kindly.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation. Worth noting even though this is INCOMPLETE: darkvision and imprecise scent are both exact, real SENSE_TYPES entries -- if a companion effect item existed, a Sense rule element would be a clean, non-mismatched fit here.
